summary: Real-case regression of the specific activity of engineered α-amylase variants.
what_it_measures: Standardized specific activity (`specific_activity_standardized`) across α-amylase sequence variants; a single-family, applied engineering target.
assay_method: Experimental enzyme activity measured on α-amylase variants in the Protein Engineering Tournament's supervised α-amylase event.
provenance: One of the 'real_case' applied datasets; α-amylase variant measurements from the Align Foundation tournament. one random split, stratified on the target (no similarity split).
when_to_use: A realistic low-n, single-enzyme engineering scenario; tests whether embeddings rank variants of one scaffold, the setting that matters for directed evolution.
caveats: Small and single-campaign; variants share a scaffold so generalization is narrow; one random split, stratified on the target. Standardized target (MAE in standardized units).

citations.authors: The Protein Engineering Tournament (Align to Innovate)
citations.title: Results of the Protein Engineering Tournament: An Open Science Benchmark for Protein Modeling and Design
